scope: Deterministic operation counts and formulas only; no execution authorization or empirical cost projection.

parent_counts.status: user protocol; confirmation identities and new split are not yet frozen

conflict.resolution: Use 24 as the requested planning count for confirmation formulas. The frozen 56-parent civilian protocol is an older engineering reference and does not define the new research split. Freeze new identities before use.

windows.status: nominal parent x four slots; retain each window outcome and reason, including no-opportunity and unknown; formal training admission rule is not frozen

branching.candidate_count_definition: K_i is the count of legal candidate actions in window i, including NOOP when legal
branching.branch_count_formula: sum_i K_i over opportunity windows where every legal candidate branch is executed
branching.candidate_continuation_step_cap_formula: sum_i K_i * min(30, max(0, H - t_i)); candidate-continuation paths only; excludes NOOP-reference and restore/prefix work
branching.candidate_continuation_step_formula: sum over executed candidate-continuation paths of observed minute transitions; this is not the complete B ledger environment-step count
branching.context_scan_formula_if_one_c1_scan_per_: sum(parent_counts) context trajectories; minute steps = context_trajectory_count * H
branching.status: No branch-count ceiling is asserted because candidate counts and the formal horizon are unresolved.

world_model.batch_unit: unique training window row (parent, repeat, window_id); legal candidate rows are concatenated within each window for forward/scoring
world_model.development_candidate_prediction_rows_fo: 3 * sum_over_development_windows(legal_candidate_count_in_window), if every seed model scores every development candidate catalog
world_model.implementation_status: planned semantics referenced by new consequence_training.py; not included as a trainer in the frozen hosted civilian package

combination.environment_step_formula: episodes * H_run when each PPO episode covers the full formal horizon
combination.basis: PPO updates count optimizer updates; environment steps count minute transitions; the new formal horizon is unresolved

confirmation.trajectory_formula: parents * (3 G seeds + 3 G+WM seeds + 1 C1)

not_estimated: Candidate counts vary by legal action mask and must be counted from retained window records, including NOOP when legal.
Branch-step totals depend on retained window outcomes, candidate catalogs, formal horizon, branch duration and termination.
No Linux whole-cgroup runtime measurement is available; CPU, wall time, RSS and storage remain null.
No formal dataset materialization, prediction workload, checkpoint bytes, or export bytes are substituted from the small local calibration.

local_calibration_context_only.use: provenance only; do not scale or extrapolate into B/C/D
